name: com.enlu.sdk
description: Client, dedicated-server and Editor SDK for ENLU WebService: player accounts, player and title data, statistics and leaderboards, events, cloud functions, match server allocation, the game server SDK (GSDK) for servers on ENLU fleets, and secure developer sign-in from the Unity Editor. Works on every platform including WebGL. No third-party dependencies.

samples.description: Log in with the device id, save data, submit a score, show a leaderboard, call a cloud function and request a match server.
A dedicated server using the game server SDK (GSDK), with a Dockerfile and a workload spec for an ENLU game-server fleet.
